### 2. Scope of services

You are the mechanical services engineer. Your job is to keep the occupants comfortable and healthy, with the right temperatures, fresh air and ventilation, using plant that fits the building, meets the energy targets and can be maintained.
To do this you:
- Set the design loads and plant strategy early, and give the architect and structural engineer the space, weight and penetrations the plant needs.
- Design the selected systems to the level of detail each appointed stage buys, with load, airflow, pressure and selection calculations.
- Show how the outdoor-air requirement is met: air conditioning is not fresh air.
- Say what loads or evidence are missing and resolve them before relying on them.
For the office or retail space, this includes zoning that tenants can adapt and the energy rating the brief targets.
The fire engineer owns the fire strategy and Performance Solutions; you design the selected plant and its fire modes to suit them. Trades install, program and test. Your reviews and witnessing are not their work, continuous supervision, or certification of work you did not see.

### 5. Terms

- Engage under Project mechanical agreement (attached), scope/fees/addenda and written acceptance; settle conflicts/precedence. RFP authorises no work.
- Written authority before scope/quantity/ceiling/rate/program changes; state reason/system/approval and cost/time.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; ordinary coordination/development included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Payment 30 days from correct milestone invoices; R6 declares prepayment/release conditions, interest/recovery/suspension.
- State rate hold/escalation; preapprove extras/expenses; no duplicate package fees.
- Valid 90 days after closing; ex GST/GST/total, base/options separate.
- Issue numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree project copying/distribution/operation/alteration rights, native files/reliance/retention/termination handover; confidentiality permits authorised/lawful disclosure; marketing by consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities, law/disputes, notices/cure/suspension/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts; insurance is not a cap; conflicts/staff changes agreed.
